title: Claimable-balance and liquidity-pool address kinds reach an account column in SEP-41 processing
severity_basis: Address kinds the account column cannot hold reached it. Fixed upstream by PR #756 (666a64d4); the linter fires at the pre-fix commit and is silent after (make lint-before-after).
